title: The Descent
note: First hour after the rite closes, from Mnehmos's interior. He queries the Vas (reserve falls 15,468 → 6,412), queries cohort bind status, language bridge, summoner roll, Severa's recovery, his own burden. Descends the seven shallow steps (his engineering won over the masons' sacred-number argument). Addresses the cohort by name. Does not explain his selection — resolution IV (writing-determined) honored.
litRPG_surface: Mnehmos's sheet is CITY-LEVEL, not personal HP/AC. Tracked: Vas Halidani reserve, next-rite eligibility, language-bridge expiry, cohort bind status, summoner roll, Severa's discernment pool, Mnehmos's burden meter.

events.note: Seven shallow steps from dais to receiving floor. The masons argued seven for sacred-number reasons; Mnehmos agreed because seven shallow are safer than five steep when carrying the weak.

events.petition: Show me only what can kill one of them before the hour turns.
events.returned: COHORT WAVE c0407606 · TRIAGE WINDOW 01:00 — per-soul medical status + LIMITS clause (no motive read · no allegiance forecast · blind to non-physical emergents)
events.honest_returns_note: Engine refused to forecast allegiance or motive. Mnehmos calls this 'Good — it refuses me the false luxury of thinking I can know more than I can.'

events.spoken: Dry wraps and heat for Aritomo. No crowding. Stand back from Salk until she lowers her arm. Cerny will rise when he chooses. Place a record-slate where Adebayo can see it.
events.note: Per-soul protocols matched to their professional reflexes. Consent floor preserved.

events.spoken: Cole Maddox. Renata Salk. Bohdan Cerny. Yuki Aritomo. Wren Adebayo.
events.note: First time the cohort hears their names from the man who chose them.

events.spoken: I am Mnehmos. I performed the rite that brought you here.
events.note: Direct attribution. Refused softening verbs (no 'were brought,' no 'fate'). First honesty is the simplest one.

events.spoken: You are in Sebastopyr. This chamber is in the Cathedral Sebastinum, above the Vas Halidani that holds the Grace I spent to bring you. The city beyond it is real. So are its risks.
events.note: Geographical fact corrected from the agent's first draft (which placed them 'in Vas Halidani' — wrong; Vas is the cistern, not the city).

events.spoken: Maddox. You were right to clear the line. And right to ask before touching.
events.note: Recognition at the right weight; not overpoured. Mnehmos saw Cole's perception fire from above.

Per resolution IV (writing-determined): Mnehmos does NOT explain his selection in the address. He names his act ('I know your names because I selected you') without explaining the why. The why is for the prose to discover, not for him to pre-load.

The System (orchestrator) substituted canonical names + behaviors per ba96fe9b and Cole's already-committed ch02. Voice, structure, and engine readouts preserved from the agent's draft; per-soul descriptions corrected to match each character's canonical behavior. Also corrected 'You are in Vas Halidani' → 'You are in Sebastopyr; this chamber is in the Cathedral Sebastinum above the Vas Halidani' (Vas is the cistern, not the city).
